    Who controls their destiny

    • Loading

    Chance to reach the conference championship game if the team wins all of its remaining conference games.

    How ACC ties are broken

    When two teams finish tied in conference play, ACC applies these steps in order until one team is ahead:

    1. Head-to-head result between the two teams
    2. Ranking-based step (CFP rank, computer composite or similar): KickTip uses its rating as a stand-in
    3. Random draw (coin toss)

    Ties among three or more teams use a similar list, starting with results among the tied teams. This is a plain-English summary of the official policy; the official text controls.

    Known limitations

    • The policy's Team Success Ranking step relies on other public rating systems, so KickTip's rating stands in for it.
    • Teams with a different number of conference games count as tied with the leader when they have the same wins or the same losses; KickTip resolves the top slot first. That is our reading of the policy wording.
    • Postseason-ineligible teams are not modeled.
